title: When the Lantern Breaks
author: Wren Kavanagh
blurb: Quentin Vane, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
